tests.name: PostgREST-only routing: rest/v1 rewritten to the data host, auth/storage/functions/realtime untouched, pass-through when unset, real client wiring
tests.reason: On staging VITE_DATA_API_URL_STAGING is unset until the proxy's staging twin is live, so the build must behave exactly as before; the community-app smoke suite proves that on the deployed chunk. The routing itself is proven here without touching any server.
